role: RR-interval-derived respiration rate: resamples RR at 4 Hz, mean-centres and Hann-windows the samples, zero-pads to a power of two, computes the power spectrum with a cached vDSP DFT and returns the 0.15-0.5 Hz peak as breaths/min, only when that peak is concentrated and not dwarfed by a slower rhythm (isBreathingPeak); otherwise nil.
toplevel: Static threshold constants for isBreathingPeak; no other top-level code.

units.does: Breaths/min from a gapless RR series (ms): times each beat by the sum of the intervals before it (cumulativeTimeAxis) and returns estimateRespirationRate(_:beatTimes:fs:).

Estimates breaths/min from RR (ms) at the given beat times (s): requires >=60 intervals with one time each and >=32 resampled points (resampleRR over those times, so a beat left out keeps its time and is interpolated across), gets the respiratory-band PSD peak when it is a breathing peak, returns peak*60 if within 6-40, else nil.
units.entry: Called by HRVAnalysisPipeline.computeANSMetrics and estimateRespirationRate(_:fs:); tests call it directly.

branches.cond: rr.count >= 60 and one time per interval

branches.effect: nil (empty/flat band, noise or leakage) returns nil
false returns nil; true returns rate

units.does: Mean-centres the series, multiplies it by a Hann window the length of the data (so the real signal tapers to zero at both ends), then zero-pads the windowed samples to the next power of two.
Single-sided power spectrum |X[k]|^2 for k=0...N/2 using the cached vDSP DFT setup; nil when setup unavailable.

Finds the max-power bin between floor(0.15/freqRes) and min(floor(0.5/freqRes), N/2) and returns its frequency when it is a breathing peak (isBreathingPeak); nil when the range is empty, the peak power is 0, or the peak is noise or leakage.

branches.effect: false returns nil (flat band, noise or leakage)

units.does: Whether the band's largest bin is breathing: the bins within ±peakHalfWidthHz (0.02 Hz, at least one bin) of it hold at least peakConcentrationMinimum (40 %) of the band's power, and it is at least peakHeightMinimum (5 %) of the strongest bin from 0.04 Hz up to the Nyquist frequency. Rejects white or 1/f noise (power spread over the band) and leakage from a slower or faster rhythm (breathing above 30/min leaves only its leakage in the band). Thresholds from synthetic five-minute windows: 95-100 % of breathing kept, 0-3 % of noise passed.

branches.cond: near-peak power >= 40 % of band power AND peak >= 5 % of the strongest bin from 0.04 Hz to Nyquist

units.does: Resamples RR onto a uniform fs grid by linear interpolation over the beat times `t`; returns rr unchanged when <4 intervals or <4 samples.

branches.cond: time axis has first and last

units.does: Beat times in seconds from cumulative RR sum (first beat at 0).
Linear interpolation between beat tIdx and tIdx+1; returns rr[tIdx] at the end of series or on a zero-width interval.

branches.effect: false returns rr[tIdx]; true returns interpolated value
